g.desc: Complete editable topknot_bun including motion exposure margin from the approved guide; all resources are local to this part.

path.desc: Closed complete surface; visible edge matches approved guide. Bun y134 and right stem y269.4 retain future motion exposure. No cutout is introduced.

head/topknot_bun; contour; Complete boundary and occlusion continuation; bun lower edge hides behind crown/front hair, earring top stem anchors inside ear. Visible edge firm, hidden perimeter unobtrusive. Pressure start/middle/end (0.4, 0.65, 0.4); thin rounded taper, crisp center and soft optical endpoints. Clipped to the complete part surface; open lines are visible accents, closed contours delimit continuous fill.

head/topknot_bun; structure; Silver lock valley sweeps from scalp-facing outer arc into the lower bun root. Crown covers middle/lower run; retain full continuation for slight motion. Visible upper valley medium, gathering root fades. Pressure start/middle/end (0.12, 0.68, 0.16); thin rounded taper, crisp center and soft optical endpoints. Clipped to the complete part surface; open lines are visible accents, closed contours delimit continuous fill.
